questionText:
Arrange the following events in Indian politics in chronological order.
 
(A) The Socialist Party was formed.
(B) The Communist Party abandoned the path of violent revolution and
decided to participate in the first general elections.
(C) Swatantra Party was formed.
(D) National Revolutionary Party was formed.
 
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.
Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
NCERT Class 12 Politics in India Since Independence (Chapter 2: Era of One-Party Dominance): (D) National Revolutionary Party (later PRI) of Mexico was founded in 1929 by Plutarco Elias Calles (p. 39 box). (A) The Congress Socialist Party leaders formed the separate Socialist Party in 1948 after Congress amended its constitution (p. 34). (B) The Communist Party of India (CPI) abandoned the path of violent revolution to participate in general elections in 1951 (p. 35). (C) Swatantra Party was formed in August 1959 under the leadership of C. Rajagopalachari (p. 40). Chronological order: (D) [1929] -> (A) [1948] -> (B) [1951] -> (C) [1959].
Hence, option (D) is correct.

solution.detailed:
Detailed Solution:
NCERT Class 12 Politics in India Since Independence (Chapter 2: Era of One-Party Dominance): (D) National Revolutionary Party (later PRI) of Mexico was founded in 1929 by Plutarco Elias Calles (p. 39 box). (B) The Communist Party of India (CPI) abandoned the path of violent revolution to participate in general elections in 1951 (p. 35). Hence, option (D) is correct.

Therefore, option (B) is the correct answer.
